notes: Added restoreRuntimeStateOnBoot so daomai-agent re-applies its own LAN-phone bridge/DHCP, proxy, nftables, tc shaping, and NIC tuning from its own database on every start (reboot or crash-restart), fixing clients not being recognized after a reboot since the prior daomai-apply.service restore read a stale, separate Python database; and changed the pre-boot-restore nftables baseline forward chain from policy accept to policy drop so nothing can leak/forward through the router before daomai-agent finishes its own apply.
